details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary demonstrates strong internal logical coherence. All statements build upon each other without contradiction. Key relationships are clearly explained: revenue/EBITDA growth (S2-S3) is contextualized against one-time effects (S4), quarterly recovery (S5) is linked to specific operational improvements (S7), and financial strengthening (S12-S15) follows from explicit actions like deleveraging and working capital management. The organization flows logically from overall performance to segment details to financial position. No unnecessary repetition or logical gaps are present. While segment figures aren't consolidated (S6 vs S2), the candidate never claims they should sum to the total, so this isn't an internal contradiction.
